home.direct.title: Direct Install (recommended)
home.direct.description: Find the game folder, prepare or reuse a compatible AC7-specific UE4SS, and install this mod. Updates keep your settings, custom notification sound, and other mods.
home.zip.title: Export universal ZIP
home.zip.description: Save the exact ZIP provided as the standalone download, for Vortex or manual installation. First prepare the AC7-specific UE4SS described in the installation guide.
home.zip.warning: This mod contains both UE4SS components and PAK files. Installation with the CreeperUX launcher is not supported.
